# TERRAFORM KNOWLEDGE BASE

## OVERVIEW

OCI infrastructure provisioning: VCN, private subnet, NAT instance, ARM compute, Bastion. All within Always Free tier.

## STRUCTURE

```
terraform/
├── main.tf             # Root module - orchestrates all resources
├── variables.tf        # Input variables
├── outputs.tf          # Exported values (IPs, OCIDs)
├── provider.tf         # OCI provider + remote state config
├── terraform.tfvars    # Environment values (git-ignored)
└── modules/
    ├── networking/     # VCN, public subnet, internet gateway
    ├── nat-instance/   # fck-nat style NAT with optional HA
    └── security/       # Cloud Guard, vulnerability scanning
```

## WHERE TO LOOK

| Task | Location | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Add compute instance | `main.tf` | Place in private subnet, no public IP |
| Modify VCN/subnet | `modules/networking/` | Security lists are allow-only |
| NAT configuration | `modules/nat-instance/` | See dedicated AGENTS.md |
| Security policies | `modules/security/` | Cloud Guard, scanning |
| SSH jump command | `outputs.tf` | `ssh_via_nat_jump` output |

## MODULE DEPENDENCIES

```
main.tf
  ├── security (independent)
  ├── networking
  │     └── receives nat_instance.security_list_id
  ├── nat_instance
  │     └── receives networking.{vcn_id, public_subnet_id}
  ├── time_sleep (90s wait for NAT cloud-init)
  └── openclaw instance
        └── depends_on time_sleep
```

## CONVENTIONS

- **No public IPs**: Compute in private subnet, access via Bastion/Tailscale
- **NAT before compute**: `time_sleep.wait_for_nat_cloudinit` ensures NAT ready
- **Image verification**: Comment includes verification command for AMI OCIDs
- **Hardcoded AD**: `mBSv:US-SANJOSE-1-AD-1` (single AD region)

## ANTI-PATTERNS

| Pattern | Why |
|---------|-----|
| Skip `time_sleep` | Compute boots without outbound connectivity |
| Apply stale plans | Re-plan if "Saved plan is stale" appears |
| Destroy openclaw accidentally | Verify plan before migration phases |
| Exceed free tier | 4 OCPU + 24GB ARM, 2x E2.1.Micro max |

## STATE MANAGEMENT

```hcl
backend "oci" {
  bucket = "terraform-state"
  key    = "infra/terraform.tfstate"
  region = "us-sanjose-1"
}
```

Bucket must exist before `terraform init`.

## OUTPUTS (KEY)

| Output | Use |
|--------|-----|
| `nat_instance_public_ip` | Jump host for SSH |
| `openclaw_private_ip` | Target for Ansible |
| `ssh_via_nat_jump` | Ready-to-use SSH command |
| `bastion_ocid` | Create bastion sessions |

## NOTES

- Private subnet defined in root `main.tf`, not networking module (depends on NAT)
- NAT instance uses nftables (AlmaLinux 10), falls back to iptables
- Cloud Guard requires tenancy-level IAM policy (auto-created)
